name: Speech-to-Text Transcription (whisper.cpp)
purpose: Transcribe one audio/media file into timestamped text segments with per-segment and overall confidence, by wrapping the whisper.cpp whisper-cli. Resolves the STT model + CLI from models.json; consumes whisper-ready 16 kHz mono s16 WAV directly and can normalize other inputs first through audio.ingest (Module 10). First stochastic/mixed skill wrapping a local model binary: populates confidence + model_provenance and routes low-confidence segments to the review queue.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Path to the source audio/media file (first audio stream). Non-whisper-ready inputs are normalized via audio.ingest per -Normalize.

inputs.name: normalize
inputs.description: auto (normalize only if not already WAV/16kHz/mono/s16) | always (force audio.ingest) | never (feed input straight to whisper).

inputs.name: language
inputs.description: Spoken language code passed to whisper (-l). The staged model is base.en (English-only).

inputs.name: best_of
inputs.description: Number of best candidates to keep (-bo).

inputs.name: max_len
inputs.description: Maximum segment length in characters (-ml); 0 = unlimited.

inputs.name: split_on_word
inputs.description: Split segments on word rather than token (-sow).

inputs.name: offset_ms
inputs.description: Start offset into the audio in ms (-ot).

inputs.name: duration_ms
inputs.description: Duration of audio to process in ms (-d); 0 = all.

inputs.name: segment_confidence_threshold
inputs.description: Segments with mean-token-probability confidence below this are flagged low_confidence and routed to the review queue.

inputs.name: max_review_segments
inputs.description: Cap on review-queue items emitted per invocation (worst-confidence segments first).

inputs.name: min_speech_seconds
inputs.description: If zero segments are produced from audio at least this long, emit one 'verify_no_speech' review item (silent-failure guard).

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: STT model id in models.json (type=stt, engine=whisper.cpp).
